name: review-analysis
description: Offline study-material analysis expert that turns a layered review-library into structured outlines, fully-expanded knowledge maps and closed-loop review reports — 100% local, zero cloud.

profession.zh: 学习资料结构化分析专家

displayDescription.en: Turns your layered review library into structured outlines, fully-expanded knowledge maps and closed-loop review reports — entirely offline, no cloud.
displayDescription.zh: 把分层复习资料离线转成结构化大纲、全展开知识图谱与闭环复习报告，纯本地零云端运行。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 分析我的复习资料库，生成结构化大纲和全展开思维导图
defaultInitPrompt.en: Analyze my review library and generate a structured outline plus a fully-expanded mind map.

quickPrompts.en: Analyze my review library and generate a structured outline plus a fully-expanded mind map.
quickPrompts.zh: 分析我的复习资料库，生成结构化大纲和全展开思维导图

quickPrompts.en: Analyze just one book and give me its syllabus outline and knowledge-point map.
quickPrompts.zh: 只分析其中一本书，给我它的考纲大纲和知识点图谱

quickPrompts.en: Resume where we left off and finish analyzing the remaining books.
quickPrompts.zh: 接着上次的分析继续，把剩下没处理的书也跑完
